candidates.label: Spending priorities: hierarchical distribution to parents, relatives, orphans, needy, and travelers
candidates.definition: In 2:215: They ask you what they should spend. Say: Whatever you spend of good is for parents and relatives and orphans and the needy and the traveler. And whatever you do of good, indeed Allah is Knowing of it.

evidence.excerpt: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَۖ قُلۡ مَآ أَنفَقۡتُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَلِلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ وَٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَ وَٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبۡنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۗ وَمَا تَفۡعَلُواْ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse establishes five-category spending hierarchy with divine omniscience as accountability.

candidates.urduLabel: انفاق کی ترجیحات: والدین، رشتہ دار، یتیم، مسکین، مسافر
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: specific priority ordering absent from existing topics. Family-first welfare model.

candidates.label: Intoxicants and gambling: acknowledged benefit outweighed by greater sin
candidates.definition: In 2:219: They ask you about wine and gambling. Say: In them is great sin and [yet some] benefit for people. But their sin is greater than their benefit.

evidence.excerpt: ۞يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡخَمۡرِ وَٱلۡمَيۡسِرِۖ قُلۡ فِيهِمَآ إِثۡمٞ كَبِيرٞ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَإِثۡمُهُمَآ أَكۡبَرُ مِن نَّفۡعِهِمَاۗ وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَۖ قُلِ ٱلۡعَفۡوَۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse provides explicit cost-benefit framework with sin declared dominant.

candidates.urduLabel: شراب اور جوا: فائدہ سے بڑھا گناہ
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: no dedicated khamr-maysir topic. Gradual prohibition methodology visible here vs. later absolute prohibition.

candidates.label: Interfaith marriage prohibition: believing slave preferred over free polytheist
candidates.definition: In 2:221: Do not marry polytheistic women until they believe. A believing slave woman is better than a polytheist even if she pleases you. Do not marry [women to] polytheistic men until they believe. A believing slave is better than a polytheist even if he pleases you. Those invite to the Fire; Allah invites to Paradise and forgiveness.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَنكِحُواْ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكَٰتِ حَتَّىٰ يُؤۡمِنَّۚ وَلَأَمَةٞ مُّؤۡمِنَةٌ خَيۡرٞ مِّن مُّشۡرِكَةٖ وَلَوۡ أَعۡجَبَتۡكُمۡۗ وَلَا تُنكِحُواْ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ حَتَّىٰ يُؤۡمِنُواْۚ وَلَعَبۡدٞ مُّؤۡمِنٌ خَيۡرٞ مِّن مُّشۡرِكٖ وَلَوۡ أَعۡجَبَكُمۡۗ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يَدۡعُونَ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ بِإِذۡنِهِۦۖ وَيُبَيِّنُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse establishes bidirectional prohibition with faith-status inversion and eschatological rationale.

candidates.urduLabel: بین المذہب شادی کی ممنوعت: ایمان کو مرتبہ پر ترجیح
candidates.notes: Overlap confirmed with interfaith-marriage. Adds explicit faith-over-class principle and dual-direction prohibition.

candidates.label: Divorce legislation: waiting periods, reconciliation rights, khul, and irrevocable divorce procedures
candidates.definition: In 2:228: Divorced women wait three quru'; husbands have reconciliation priority; reciprocal rights with male darajah. In 2:229: Divorce twice; retain honorably or release graciously; khul ransom when fearing hudud failure. In 2:230: Third divorce requires intervening marriage. In 2:231-232: No harm-retention; no preventing remarriage.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلۡمُطَلَّقَٰتُ يَتَرَبَّصۡنَ بِأَنفُسِهِنَّ ثَلَٰثَةَ قُرُوٓءٖۚ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَهُنَّ أَن يَكۡتُمۡنَ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ فِيٓ أَرۡحَامِهِنَّ إِن كُنَّ يُؤۡمِنَّ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ وَبُعُولَتُهُنَّ أَحَقُّ بِرَدِّهِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ إِنۡ أَرَادُوٓاْ إِصۡلَٰحٗاۚ وَلَهُنَّ مِثۡلُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَيۡهِنَّ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِۚ وَلِلرِّجَالِ عَلَيۡهِنَّ دَرَجَةٞۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
evidence.rationale: Establishes waiting period, reconciliation priority, and reciprocal rights framework.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلطَّلَٰقُ مَرَّتَانِۖ فَإِمۡسَاكُۢ بِمَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ تَسۡرِيحُۢ بِإِحۡسَٰنٖۗ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمۡ أَن تَأۡخُذُواْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَيۡتُمُوهُنَّ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّآ أَن يَخَافَآ أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِۖ فَإِنۡ خِفۡتُمۡ أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡهِمَا فِيمَا ٱفۡتَدَتۡ بِهِۦۗ تِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَعۡتَدُوهَاۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Defines revocable divorce count and khul mechanism.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا تَحِلُّ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدُ حَتَّىٰ تَنكِحَ زَوۡجًا غَيۡرَهُۥۗ فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡهِمَآ أَن يَتَرَاجَعَآ إِن ظَنَّآ أَن يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَتِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ يُبَيِّنُهَا لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Establishes irrevocable divorce rule with intervening marriage requirement.

candidates.urduLabel: طلاق کا قانون: عدت، رجوع، خلع، اور حتمی طلاق
candidates.notes: Overlap confirmed with divorce-types and khul-divorce. This candidate captures unified legislative context across multiple verses.

candidates.label: Breastfeeding legislation: two-year period, paternal provision, capacity principle, and mutual weaning consent
candidates.definition: In 2:233: Mothers breastfeed two complete years for whoever wishes completion. Upon the father is their provision and clothing bil-ma'ruf. No soul burdened beyond capacity. No mother harmed through child nor father through child. Weaning by mutual consent and consultation. Wet-nursing permitted with fair payment.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَٱلۡوَٰلِدَٰتُ يُرۡضِعۡنَ أَوۡلَٰدَهُنَّ حَوۡلَيۡنِ كَامِلَيۡنِۖ لِمَنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يُتِمَّ ٱلرَّضَاعَةَۚ وَعَلَى ٱلۡمَوۡلُودِ لَهُۥ رِزۡقُهُنَّ وَكِسۡوَتُهُنَّ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِۚ لَا تُكَلَّفُ نَفۡسٌ إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ لَا تُضَآرَّ وَٰلِدَةُۢ بِوَلَدِهَا وَلَا مَوۡلُودٞ لَّهُۥ بِوَلَدِهِۦۚ وَعَلَى ٱلۡوَارِثِ مِثۡلُ ذَٰلِكَۗ فَإِنۡ أَرَادَا فِصَالًا عَن تَرَاضٖ مِّنۡهُمَا وَتَشَاوُرٖ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡهِمَاۗ وَإِنۡ أَرَدتُّمۡ أَن تَسۡتَرۡضِعُوٓاْ أَوۡلَٰدَكُمۡ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذَا سَلَّمۡتُم مَّآ ءَاتَيۡتُم بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِۗ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse provides comprehensive nursing legislation with capacity principle and mutual consent requirements.

candidates.urduLabel: دودھ پلانے کا قانون: دو سال، باپ کی ذمہ داری، صلاحیت، باہمی رضامندی
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: no dedicated rada'ah/breastfeeding topic. Capacity principle (la tukallafu nafsun illa wus'aha) is jurisprudentially foundational.

candidates.label: Oaths: unintentional (laghw) exemption with heart-intention accountability
candidates.definition: In 2:224-225: Do not make Allah an excuse through oaths against righteousness, piety, and peacemaking. Allah does not hold you accountable for laghw in your oaths but holds you accountable for what your hearts have earned. Allah is Forgiving, Forbearing.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ ٱللَّهَ عُرۡضَةٗ لِّأَيۡمَٰنِكُمۡ أَن تَبَرُّواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ وَتُصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِۚ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Prohibits instrumentalizing divine name to avoid moral duties.

evidence.excerpt: لَّا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغۡوِ فِيٓ أَيۡمَٰنِكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ قُلُوبُكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Distinguishes unintentional from intentional oath accountability centered on heart.

candidates.urduLabel: قسمیں: غیر ارادی چھوٹ معافی، دل کی نیت پر مواخذہ
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: no dedicated oaths/ayman topic. Heart-as-moral-locus principle connects to ikhlas-sincerity.

candidates.label: Widow provisions: four-month-ten-day iddah, one-year bequest, and autonomous remarriage
candidates.definition: In 2:234: Widows wait four months and ten days; no blame for acceptable self-conduct after term. In 2:235: Indirect proposals permitted; secret commitments prohibited. In 2:240: Bequest of one year maintenance without expulsion; voluntary departure permitted.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوۡنَ مِنكُمۡ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَتَرَبَّصۡنَ بِأَنفُسِهِنَّ أَرۡبَعَةَ أَشۡهُرٖ وَعَشۡرٗاۖ فَإِذَا بَلَغۡنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِيمَا فَعَلۡنَ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِنَّ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Establishes widow iddah duration and post-term autonomy.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِيمَا عَرَّضۡتُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ خِطۡبَةِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ أَوۡ أَكۡنَنتُمۡ فِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّكُمۡ سَتَذۡكُرُونَهُنَّ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُوَاعِدُوهُنَّ سِرًّا إِلَّآ أَن تَقُولُواْ قَوۡلٗا مَّعۡرُوفٗاۚ وَلَا تَعۡزِمُواْ عُقۡدَةَ ٱلنِّكَاحِ حَتَّىٰ يَبۡلُغَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ أَجَلَهُۥۚ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ فَٱحۡذَرُوهُۚ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Permits indirect proposal while prohibiting secret commitments.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوۡنَ مِنكُمۡ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَصِيَّةٗ لِّأَزۡوَٰجِهِم مَّتَٰعًا إِلَى ٱلۡحَوۡلِ غَيۡرَ إِخۡرَاجٖۚ فَإِنۡ خَرَجۡنَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِي مَا فَعَلۡنَ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِنَّ مِن مَّعۡرُوفٖۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: One-year housing/maintenance bequest with voluntary departure option.

candidates.urduLabel: بیوہ کی حقوق: عدت، وصیت، اور دوبارہ شادی
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: no dedicated widow/iddah topic. Economic security provisions distinctive from divorce iddah.

candidates.label: Middle prayer (salat al-wusta): specific maintenance command with devout standing
candidates.definition: In 2:238: Maintain the prayers and the middle prayer (salat al-wusta), and stand before Allah devoutly obedient (qanitin).

evidence.excerpt: حَٰفِظُواْ عَلَى ٱلصَّلَوَٰتِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱلۡوُسۡطَىٰ وَقُومُواْ لِلَّهِ قَٰنِتِينَ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse singles out middle prayer for special emphasis alongside general prayer maintenance.

candidates.urduLabel: وسطی نماز: حفاظت اور عبادت میں کھڑے ہونا
candidates.notes: Overlap with five-daily-prayers. Specificity of 'wusta' identification remains scholarly debate (Asr most common view).

candidates.label: Good loan to Allah (qard hasan): charitable spending with manifold divine multiplication
candidates.definition: In 2:245: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over? And Allah withholds and grants abundance, and to Him you will be returned.

evidence.excerpt: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يُقۡرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥٓ أَضۡعَافٗا كَثِيرَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَقۡبِضُ وَيَبۡصُۜطُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse frames charity as lending to Allah with guaranteed manifold return.

candidates.urduLabel: اللہ کو خوبصورت قرض: خیرات پر کئی گنا اجر
candidates.notes: Overlap with sadaqah-jariyah and giving. Qard-hasan metaphor distinctively personalizes divine reciprocity.

candidates.label: Cosmic balance (daf' Allah): divine checking of people through others prevents earth corruption
candidates.definition: In 2:251: If it were not for Allah checking [some] people by means of others, the earth would have been corrupted, but Allah is full of bounty to the worlds.

evidence.excerpt: فَهَزَمُوهُم بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَتَلَ دَاوُۥدُ جَالُوتَ وَءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَعَلَّمَهُۥ مِمَّا يَشَآءُۗ وَلَوۡلَا دَفۡعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعۡضَهُم بِبَعۡضٖ لَّفَسَدَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ذُو فَضۡلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse articulates cosmic sociological principle justifying conflict as corruption-prevention mechanism.

candidates.urduLabel: کائناتی توازن: اللہ کا لوگوں کو روکنا زمین کو فساد سے بچاتا ہے
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: daf' Allah as political-theological principle distinct from environmental fasad. Connects warfare ethics to cosmology.
